info.name: Didit Verification Case Blueprints API
info.description: Identity verification API. Authenticate with x-api-key header.

request.description: Retrieve a blueprint, including its connected creation sources (AML config, transaction rules, workflow nodes) and which blueprints escalate to it.
Partially update a blueprint's general settings or content_config.

response.name: The review policy changed since expected_version. Review the latest version before retrying.

request.description: Delete a blueprint. Deletion always succeeds and does not touch the blueprint's cases: existing cases keep their blueprint reference and its settings continue to apply to them. A deleted blueprint no longer appears in blueprint lists and can no longer be chosen as a transfer target; if a maker blueprint is deleted while a resolution is pending 4-eyes approval, a rejected resolution leaves the case on the checker blueprint.
Copy one or more presets into the application as editable blueprints. Idempotent per preset_key; omit preset_keys to install every preset not yet installed.

response.name: No new presets to install (all requested presets already exist).

request.description: List the four built-in presets (Screening hit, AML investigation, Suspicious activity, KYC review) with their content_config and whether each is already installed on this application.
List case blueprints for the application.

Create a case blueprint: general settings (assignment, escalation, transfer, 4-eyes pairing) plus content_config, the six sections that drive the case page. Set publish=false to create an unpublished draft; Publish creates its first live version. Discarding a never-published draft deletes it.

response.name: Name over 24 chars, empty assignee_pool, or a cross-referenced blueprint (escalation/checker) not found.
